responsibility: Declares the ARC target’s command-line options and option enums for GCC’s option generator. It describes endianness, CPU/tuning selection, hardware-extension toggles, code model and ABI knobs, FPU and multiplier modes, Linux/assembler compatibility aliases, deferred interrupt-register options, and related defaults/variables that drive ARC backend configuration.
same_name_distinction: This file is the option-definition input for GCC’s option generator, declaring -m ARC switches, enums, and variables; unlike arc.cc and arc.h it does not implement or configure target behavior via C/C++ macros directly, and unlike arc.md it contains no RTL instruction patterns.
